title: How Multi-Tenant Portal policy templates are created, assigned to tenants and tenant groups, reordered, edited in ZIA and deleted

prose.label: Deleting.
prose.text: {{delete-behaviour}} The Edit and Delete steps for portal items are in [[shared.multi-tenant-portal.administration]].

definition.statement: A partner can create multiple policy templates and apply them to tenant accounts.

quotes: The Zscaler partners can have multiple policy templates created and have them applied to the tenant's account.

one-template.statement: A tenant or tenant group can be associated to only one policy template.

quotes: A tenant or tenant group can be associated to only one policy template.

add-fields.statement: The Add Policy Template window takes a Name, a Cloud (where the tenant is provisioned), Tenants (listed based on the cloud selected, with Add Cloud to add another cloud) and Tenant Groups, and is saved with Save and Edit Policies.

quotes: Name: Enter a name for the policy template.
Cloud: Select the cloud on which the tenant is provisioned.
Tenants: Select tenants from the drop-down menu. The list of tenants available is based on the cloud selected.
Add Cloud: Click Add Cloud to add another cloud. You can add tenants under the selected cloud.
Tenant Groups: Select tenant groups from the drop-down menu.

rule-reorder.statement: The Allow Policy Rule Reorder option is disabled by default, so the policy is enforced at top priority; if enabled, ZIA Admin Portal admins can change the order of the policy in the Rule Order option.

quotes: Allow Policy Rule Reorder: This option is disabled by default and hence the policy is enforced at top priority. If enabled, the ZIA Admin Portal admins can change the order of the policy in the Rule Order option (Policy > URL & Cloud App Control > Edit URL Filtering Rule).

description-limit.statement: A policy template description is optional and cannot exceed 256 characters.

quotes: (Optional) Enter a description for the policy template. The description cannot exceed 256 characters.

list-columns.statement: The policy template list shows No. of Tenants (tenants assigned the same template) and the actions Edit, Delete and Edit Policy Template in ZIA.

quotes: No. of Tenants: The total number of tenants assigned with the same policy template.
The actions available are Edit, Delete, and Edit Policy Template in ZIA.

delete-behaviour.statement: Deleting a policy template removes it from the Multi-Tenant Portal database, but the configured template and policies remain in the ZIA policy configurations; the ZIA admin gets full access to the template, which was initially read-only.

quotes: Deleting a policy template removes that policy template from the Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners database, but the configured template and policies are available in the ZIA policy configurations.
the ZIA admin gets full access to that template (initially accessible as read-only)

edit-in-zia.statement: The Edit Policy Template on ZIA action redirects to the ZIA Admin Portal, where policies can be saved and synchronized for multiple tenants under multiple clouds.

quotes: You can save and synchronize policies for multiple tenants under multiple clouds.
Click the Edit Policy Template on ZIA icon to redirect to the ZIA Admin Portal.

unsynced-fields.statement: In a URL Filtering rule edited through a policy template, Rule Label, Source IP Groups, Users, Groups, Departments, Locations, Location Groups, Devices, Device Groups, Device Trust Level and HTTP Header Profiles are not synchronized with the user and are not editable.

quotes: The fields such as Rule Label, Source IP Groups, Users, Groups, Departments, Locations, Location Groups, Devices, Device Groups, Device Trust Level, and HTTP Header Profiles in the URL Filtering Rule are not synchronized with the user and are not editable.

rule-order-editable.statement: The Rule Order option in a URL Filtering rule edited through a policy template is only editable if Allow Policy Rule Reorder is enabled in the Multi-Tenant Portal.

quotes: Rule Order: Select the rule order from the drop-down menu.
This option is only editable if you enable Allow Policy Rule Reorder in the Multi-Tenant Portal (Policy Template > Add Policy Template > Allow Policy Rule Reorder).
